stages.name: Foundation
stages.exit_criteria: Build, test, document, and debug a typed Python API backed by SQL.

stages.name: Cloud and Deployment
stages.exit_criteria: Ship the service through CI into a reproducible container and Kubernetes environment managed as code.

stages.name: AI Engineering
stages.exit_criteria: Build a grounded, evaluated RAG and tool-calling workflow with explicit failure boundaries.

stages.name: Forward Deployed Engineering
stages.exit_criteria: Discover, design, prototype, deploy, troubleshoot, and explain a solution for a realistic customer.

stages.name: Advanced Production AI
stages.exit_criteria: Defend the capstone's security, reliability, scalability, evaluation, cost, and rollout decisions in an interview loop.

modules.title: Python for builders
modules.outcome: Write typed, modular Python with tests, exceptions, logging, and command-line interfaces.
modules.challenge: Repair a brittle API client and prove its retry behavior with tests.
modules.evidence: A pull request containing the repaired client, tests, and a short design note.

modules.title: Git, Linux, networking, and runtime basics
modules.outcome: Use branches, shell tools, processes, ports, DNS, HTTP, TLS, and logs to investigate a failing service.
modules.challenge: Explain why a healthy process is unreachable from another container.
modules.evidence: A command journal with hypotheses, observations, and the confirmed root cause.

modules.title: SQL, data modeling, and data quality
modules.outcome: Design relational schemas, write joins and aggregations, and protect ingestion with quality constraints.
modules.challenge: Find and prevent duplicate events without hiding legitimate repeats.
modules.evidence: Schema, investigation queries, constraints, and a data-quality report.

modules.title: REST APIs and backend services
modules.outcome: Build a validated, versioned API with authentication, idempotency, errors, and contract tests.
modules.challenge: Make a create operation safe when a client retries after a timeout.
modules.evidence: OpenAPI contract, service code, tests, and an idempotency decision record.

modules.title: Software design and system-design fundamentals
modules.outcome: Separate domain, integration, and delivery concerns and reason about availability, consistency, caching, queues, and failure.
modules.challenge: Decompose a synchronous workflow that fails when one customer system is slow.
modules.evidence: Context/container diagram and two architecture decision records.

modules.title: Docker and container security
modules.outcome: Build a small, non-root, observable container with explicit configuration and health checks.
modules.challenge: Fix a container that is healthy locally but fails under a read-only filesystem.
modules.evidence: Dockerfile, image metadata, vulnerability report, and remediation notes.

modules.title: Kubernetes fundamentals
modules.outcome: Deploy, configure, scale, observe, and debug an application using core Kubernetes objects.
modules.challenge: Resolve CrashLoopBackOff caused by a missing secret and misleading readiness probe.
modules.evidence: Manifests, kubectl investigation log, and a recovery runbook.

modules.title: CI/CD and GitHub Actions
modules.outcome: Create least-privilege pipelines for quality, security, artifacts, and controlled deployment.
modules.challenge: Prevent untrusted pull-request code from receiving deployment credentials.
modules.evidence: Green workflow, failed quality-gate example, and pipeline threat notes.

modules.title: Cloud architecture across AWS, Azure, and GCP
modules.outcome: Map identity, compute, networking, storage, databases, observability, and AI services across clouds.
modules.challenge: Choose a primary cloud for a regulated customer without pretending services are identical.
modules.evidence: Weighted decision matrix and a one-page customer recommendation.

modules.title: Terraform, monitoring, and production deployment
modules.outcome: Provision a reproducible environment and define logs, metrics, traces, alerts, rollback, and ownership.
modules.challenge: Recover safely from drift and a partially failed deployment.
modules.evidence: Terraform plan, deployment record, dashboard sketch, and rollback test.

modules.title: LLM and Generative AI fundamentals
modules.outcome: Explain tokens, context, sampling, latency, model selection, hallucination, and the training/inference boundary.
modules.challenge: Compare two models using a controlled dataset instead of anecdotal prompts.
modules.evidence: Experiment design, raw outputs, metrics, cost estimate, and limitations.

modules.title: Prompt engineering and structured prompting
modules.outcome: Treat prompts, schemas, examples, refusal rules, and tool descriptions as versioned behavioral contracts.
modules.challenge: Produce schema-valid outputs across adversarial and ambiguous inputs.
modules.evidence: Prompt template, golden dataset, schema checks, and regression report.

modules.title: Embeddings and vector databases
modules.outcome: Select embeddings, chunking, metadata, filters, indexes, and retrieval metrics for a use case.
modules.challenge: Improve recall without leaking another tenant's document.
modules.evidence: Retrieval benchmark with recall@k, latency, filters, and failure analysis.

modules.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
modules.outcome: Build ingestion, retrieval, generation, citations, abstention, and evaluation as separable stages.
modules.challenge: Diagnose whether a bad answer is caused by ingestion, retrieval, context, or generation.
modules.evidence: RAG assistant, trace, evaluation results, and failure taxonomy.

modules.title: AI agents and tool-calling workflows
modules.outcome: Build bounded plans with typed tools, least privilege, approvals, idempotency, timeouts, and audit trails.
modules.challenge: Prevent a retried tool call from creating two customer tickets.
modules.evidence: Agent trace, tool schemas, safety tests, and side-effect policy.

modules.title: AI evaluation and quality engineering
modules.outcome: Combine deterministic tests, retrieval metrics, model graders, human review, red-team cases, and online signals.
modules.challenge: Catch a critical-segment regression hidden by an improved average score.
modules.evidence: Versioned dataset, evaluation runner, segment dashboard, and release gate.

modules.title: Customer discovery and success definition
modules.outcome: Separate symptoms from root problems and define users, workflows, constraints, risks, data, and measurable value.
modules.challenge: Turn 'we need a chatbot' into a testable problem statement and non-goals.
modules.evidence: Discovery brief, stakeholder map, open questions, baseline, and success metrics.

modules.title: Solution architecture and customer integration
modules.outcome: Design the data, identity, API, model, deployment, evaluation, and operating boundaries of a customer solution.
modules.challenge: Integrate a legacy API with strict rate limits and incomplete contracts.
modules.evidence: Architecture, interface contracts, threat model, risk register, and ADRs.

modules.title: Rapid prototyping and production planning
modules.outcome: Time-box uncertainty, build a vertical slice, demonstrate evidence, and define the route to production.
modules.challenge: Deliver a useful prototype without hiding production gaps behind demo polish.
modules.evidence: Demo, evaluation report, assumption log, production gap analysis, and delivery plan.

modules.title: Production troubleshooting and customer communication
modules.outcome: Triage an incident, mitigate impact, preserve evidence, communicate clearly, and drive corrective actions.
modules.challenge: Handle a latency and cost spike while answer quality is degrading for one segment.
modules.evidence: Timeline, status updates, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and follow-up review.

modules.title: AI security, identity, and secrets
modules.outcome: Threat-model prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, model supply chain, authentication, authorization, and secrets.
modules.challenge: Stop indirect prompt injection from turning retrieved content into a privileged instruction.
modules.evidence: Data-flow diagram, threat model, abuse cases, controls, and residual risks.

modules.title: Reliability, observability, and performance
modules.outcome: Define SLOs and instrument the end-to-end path with correlation, traces, metrics, logs, alerts, and runbooks.
modules.challenge: Find a retrieval latency regression that is invisible in aggregate request latency.
modules.evidence: SLOs, dashboard, trace analysis, alert test, and runbook.

modules.title: Scalability and cost optimization
modules.outcome: Load-test queues, models, retrieval, tools, and storage and optimize without violating quality targets.
modules.challenge: Reduce cost per successful task while preserving tail latency and critical-segment quality.
modules.evidence: Workload model, load results, cost model, bottleneck analysis, and chosen trade-offs.

modules.title: Customer capstone and interview loop
modules.outcome: Defend a complete solution from discovery through operations and demonstrate it under failure.
modules.challenge: Present the solution to an executive, an architect, and an on-call engineer at their respective level of detail.
modules.evidence: Public release, demo, design review, incident drill, case-study write-up, and mock interview scores.
